title: The Power of Star Creators: Evidence from the Live Streaming Industry
year_in_article: 2025 (JMR 63(1), 2026 issue; copyright 2025; batch year 2022 appears wrong)
eligible_reason: Single adoption date per analysis and a synthetic difference-in-differences estimator. The main analysis studies one star creator's exit (Ninja left Twitch on August 1, 2019): one treated category (Fortnite) versus five control categories, and FN streamers versus control-category streamers, all treated on the same day. The robustness analysis of Shroud's exit (October 24, 2019; four treated categories) is a separate single-date event. Estimation uses synthetic DiD (Arkhangelsky et al. 2021) with unit and time weights selected via the two-step synthetic control test, after residualizing outcomes on time-varying event controls (season, update, esports). No multi-cohort staggered design and no plain TWFE specification.
design_notes: Category level: 1 treated + 5 control categories, daily, 60 days pre / 60 days post, SDiD with weights in Table 4, outcomes residualized on season/update/esports dummies; Table 5 (viewers tau=-15,197.70 (4,004.03); channels tau=-1,001.74 (86.36); N=720). Individual level: 1,024 treated FN streamers vs 945 control streamers, daily duration and log(1+viewers), SDiD with TWFE, clustered by streamer; Tables 6-7 with Partner interaction; Tables 8-9 ten-day-bin dynamic effects; Tables 10-12 Shroud exit. Sun and Abraham (2021) cited only as an example of a dynamic DiD pretrend plot.
modern_estimators_named: synthetic DiD (Arkhangelsky et al. 2021); Sun-Abraham cited for dynamic-DiD plotting only

ineligible_specs.outcome: daily concurrent viewers, residualized on season/update/esports dummies
ineligible_specs.fe: category FE, day FE with SDiD unit and time weights
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: single treated unit and single adoption date; synthetic DiD weights; time-varying controls

ineligible_specs.outcome: daily streaming duration in focal category (minutes)
ineligible_specs.fe: streamer FE, day FE with SDiD weights
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; synthetic DiD weights; time-varying controls

data_availability_statement: No availability statement found. Data were collected from SullyGnome (third-party Twitch archive), Social Blade and Google Trends, so they are scraped/re-collectable in principle; no package is referenced in the text.
screener_notes: Flagged by 'Sun and Abraham' and 'two-way fixed effects' hits, but the only TWFE is inside the SDiD objective with a single treated cohort. Not a candidate for re-estimation.
